statements.proposition: The default (JavaScript, no --typescript) generator behaviour is unchanged by this pull request.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: Read from the diff; generators were not run. The JS-file selection itself is preserved (component_extension returns jsx/js when typescript is false), but the default path is changed elsewhere: the generated bin/dev template, which every install gets, now appends '--route hello_world' by default and drops the LoadError fallback; the existing dev_spec expectation was loosened (no longer checks the arguments). The Redux default path no longer runs 'npm install redux react-redux' but uses add_npm_dependencies / package-manager-specific commands, and base_generator replaces 'run "npm install ..."' with system(...). The pull request's own CHANGELOG entry calls the bin/dev default a change. So '100% backward compatibility' of default behaviour is not accurate in the strict sense; whether this counts as breaking was not settled.
evidence: gh api pulls/1786/files: templates/base/base/bin/dev modified (+12/-9): adds DEFAULT_ROUTE = "hello_world" and pushes '--route' into ARGV unless present; removes the begin/rescue LoadError fallback
spec/react_on_rails/binstubs/dev_spec.rb modified: 'with(ARGV)' expectation replaced by an argument-less expect
react_with_redux_generator.rb patch: '-        run "npm install redux react-redux"' replaced by add_npm_dependencies + install_packages_with_fallback
base_generator.rb patch: five 'run "npm install ..."' calls replaced by system("npm", ...)
CHANGELOG.md patch: 'Smart bin/dev defaults: Generated bin/dev script now automatically navigates to /hello_world'

statements.proposition: This pull request is purely additive, with no breaking changes.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: 'Purely additive' is contradicted by the diff: existing files and behaviour are modified (bin/dev template default route, npm install invocations changed from run to system, existing dev_spec expectation weakened, package.json 'dependencies' key removed, yarn.lock rewritten, package-lock.json added). 'No breaking changes' was not separately settled; labelled FALSE on the 'purely additive' part of the sentence.
